reviewNotes: HOLD / canonical-backstage. Current first-party evidence establishes the Pay&Go+ starter promo and top-up validity, but also a separate automatic-deactivation rule after more than six months without use. Preserve that condition instead of flattening the route to EUR10/year.

events.outcome: Current Proximus pages say Pay&Go is valid 12 months after first call and >EUR5 top-up extends 12 months, but the current FAQ separately says a card not used for more than 6 months is automatically deactivated. The reviewed page does not define exactly which activity satisfies “used”; annual top-up alone must not be treated as sufficient.

data.acquisitionSummary: Current Pay&Go+ web promo lists EUR5 purchase for EUR10 credit + 3GB and free SIM delivery, valid through 2026-11-01. Identity verification is mandatory before first use.

keep.action: A top-up above EUR5 extends formal card validity 12 months; EUR5 extends only one month. Separately, Proximus says a Pay&Go card not used for more than 6 months is automatically deactivated, so perform qualifying use inside six months and do not model this as a simple EUR10/year passive-retention route.

data.chinaActivation: International identity documents are accepted, but current online identity verification for international documents requires proof of residence in Belgium; this is not a China-first acquisition route.
data.kyc: Mandatory prepaid identification. International passport/EU ID is accepted; current online flow also requests Belgian proof of residence for international documents.
data.payment: Current web page supports secure online payment; exact foreign-card acceptance is not reconciled.
data.roamingSms: EU-zone roaming is documented; non-EU long-term incoming-SMS reliability is unverified.
data.refund: Unused credit refund can be requested in some operator-switch cases, but automatic deactivation after >6 months no use is stated as non-refundable.
data.holdReason: Formal 12-month top-up validity is constrained by a separate 6-month no-use deactivation rule whose qualifying-use semantics are not fully defined; foreign online KYC also requires Belgian residence proof.
data.tariffSummary: Pay&Go+: >EUR5 top-up extends 12 months, but >6 months without use can auto-deactivate the card.
guideSteps: Acquire and identify the Pay&Go+ SIM under current Belgian rules.
Use the line within each six-month inactivity window and keep the exact qualifying-use action documented for your account.
Use a top-up above EUR5 when a full 12-month validity extension is needed; do not assume annual top-up alone defeats the separate inactivity rule.
